releaseNotes:
- Beta: Screen Translate (Circle to Search) translates and places text at the original position, color, and scale. It supports every language, although quality may be lower for some difficult languages.
- Removed Cerebras and added NVIDIA NIM with multiple fast, free models. NVIDIA's model list and priority order update automatically from the author's benchmarks every two hours.
- Model fallback now follows provider-reported reset times, skips models that definitely lack enough tokens, and advances more reliably after credit, payload, timeout, or retired-model failures.
- Result overlays now show the provider and model that produced each result.
- Reduced more system-side overlay delay, so result appearance depends much more directly on model speed. Selected overlay text can now be copied with Ctrl+C instead of requiring right-click and Copy.
- Improved the stability of Image to 3D and Image to SVG.
- Optional interfaces, workers, runtimes, models, and supporting tools now download only when needed and can be removed separately, reducing the base application size. First use may require a download.
- Downloaded Tools removal now closes the feature or worker using an item before deleting it; Clean All also clears recorded recovery copies instead of leaving old downloaded packages behind.
- Downloaded Tools now refreshes installed status and size immediately after a background download, without reopening the window.
- Reduced the Windows EXE and Android APK sizes.
- SGT Record opens faster, accelerates the first video export, and improves the crop interface.
- Added a Settings option to disable the startup splash/animation completely.
- The main SGT window now reliably remembers its size and position, with more consistent spacing and alignment across the interface.
- Presets and model-priority lists now have clearer drag-and-drop reordering.
- Fixed an issue where the glow animation for some presets could continue spinning until the application was closed.
- Android inherits several fixes from SGT on Windows.
